limitations: Commercial notes (sources/commercial_notes.md) are grounding evidence for semantic judgments but are not modeled as a separate mechanical relation; judgments must cite them in grounding packets where used.
Purpose-layer row inclusion, acquisition-relevance filtering, dependency classification, and identifier rendering transforms are not World relations per KERNEL and intention contract.

relations.name: invoice_observation
relations.meaning: A billed invoice as represented in authoritative billing with sourced amount, currency, period, and payment status.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/billing/invoices.json row by invoice_id.
relations.construction_rule: Parse invoices.json; emit one tuple per invoice; invoice referent is invoice:<invoice_id>; copy fields verbatim without canonicalization.

relations.name: crm_account_observation
relations.meaning: A CRM customer account row with its sourced account name.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/crm.csv row by crm_account_id.
relations.construction_rule: Parse crm.csv; emit one tuple per row; account referent is crm:<crm_account_id>; copy account_name verbatim.

relations.name: registry_entity_observation
relations.meaning: A company registry row with sourced company number and legal name.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/company_registry.csv row by company_number.
relations.construction_rule: Parse company_registry.csv; emit one tuple per row; entity referent is registry:<company_number>; copy legal_name verbatim.

relations.name: contract_document_observation
relations.meaning: A contract or SOW document header with sourced counterparty text, document type, term dates, and mechanically compiled temporal active flag from explicit expiry or stated term mechanics.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to sources/contracts/<filename> header fields.
relations.construction_rule: Parse each sources/contracts/*.md header; contract referent is contract:<filename without .md>; contract_id is the filename stem; set active false when an explicit expiry date is in the past or the document states non-renewal, true for open-ended auto-renew or rolling terms without passed expiry, otherwise from explicit expiry versus source review date.

relations.name: contract_clause_observation
relations.meaning: A parsed contractual clause kind present in a contract document, independent of any purpose-specific relevance filter.
relations.grounding_contract: One SOURCE grounding per tuple pointing to the contract section text that supports the parsed clause_kind.
relations.construction_rule: Parse clause sections from sources/contracts/*.md; emit one tuple per distinct clause_kind per contract using vocabulary change_of_control_consent, change_of_control_termination, assignment_notice_or_consent, assignment_consent, assignment_notice, assignment_competitor_prohibition, competitor_assignment_prohibition, exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term as supported by section text.

relations.name: account_contract_code_correspondence
relations.meaning: Deterministic correspondence between a CRM account identifier token and a contract filename code token.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding from crm_account_observation and contract_document_observation rows showing the matched tokens.
relations.construction_rule: Match crm_account_id prefix before hyphen to the contract filename token immediately after MSA- or SOW- (e.g. HEL-441 to MSA-HELION-2019, MER-55 to MSA-MER-2024).

relations.name: legal_form_mechanical_equivalence
relations.meaning: Exact legal-form variant normalization between two name strings that differ only in permitted corporate suffix or punctuation of the same registered name.
relations.grounding_contract: Mechanical normalization rule application with optional SOURCE citation to registry legal_name when one side is registered.
relations.construction_rule: Emit pairs where normalized forms match under exact legal-form variant rules (Ltd/Limited, Inc./Incorporated, LLC, GmbH spacing) without fuzzy or orthographic similarity beyond permitted suffix variants.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: Assert disposition only with bounded establishing evidence; absent evidence leave candidate pair unresolved or omit until adjudicated.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate candidate unordered pairs along required commercial relationship topology: CRM account, its billed name, governing contract referent, and registry entity candidates tied to that relationship via account_contract_code_correspondence and name overlap hints; exclude globally all-pairs comparison.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Insufficient evidence to assert SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT.

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: An invoice is confidently associated with a governing contract, or the billed-name to contract-counterparty linkage remains unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet chaining billing billed_name, contract counterparty_text, identity_judgment outcomes, and commercial notes where cited; asserted requires establishing evidence beyond name compatibility alone.
relations.construction_rule: For each invoice_observation tuple, adjudicate association to candidate contracts reachable through account_contract_code_correspondence and identity evidence; emit asserted only with establishing linkage evidence.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each invoice, generate candidates against contract_document_observation tuples linked by account_contract_code_correspondence from CRM rows connected via identity_judgment or mechanical equivalence to billing:<billed_name>.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Billed name and contract counterparty cannot be confidently joined.

relations.name: commercial_relationship_identity_candidate
relations.meaning: A candidate identity pair required to connect CRM, billing, contract, and registry referents along a commercial relationship span.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding listing input tuples from account_contract_code_correspondence, invoice_observation, contract_document_observation, and registry_entity_observation.
relations.construction_rule: Derive undirected candidate pairs for each CRM account in the commercial span: crm:<id> to billing:<billed_name>, crm:<id> to contract:<stem>, contract:<stem> to registry:<company_number> for registry rows that are name-compatible candidates, and billing:<billed_name> to registry:<company_number> where applicable.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Span expansion follows account_contract_code_correspondence plus invoice rows sharing billed names with relationship evidence; do not emit exhaustive all-pairs across the data room.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: An invoice whose sourced status is open.
relations.grounding_contract: DERIVATION grounding from invoice_observation row where status equals open.
